recipes.name: Morning brief
recipes.instructions: Rank what needs me today: replies owed, meetings, deadlines and alerts. Link every item to its source.

recipes.name: Inbox triage
recipes.instructions: File notifications and FYIs. Flag mail from my manager and stakeholders. Never delete.

recipes.name: Draft replies
recipes.trigger_label: Event · mail that needs a reply
recipes.instructions: Draft replies in my style and save them as Outlook drafts. Sending always asks me.

recipes.name: Mention digest
recipes.instructions: List unanswered Slack and Teams mentions and DMs, oldest first.

recipes.name: Refresh-failure watch
recipes.instructions: Alert on failed or overrunning refreshes. Retry once only for known transient errors on datasets I own.

recipes.name: Nightly digest
recipes.instructions: List everything done without asking today, each with an undo.

recipes.name: Incident intake and triage
recipes.instructions: Parse the assignment email, pseudonymise names, translate, detect on-behalf requests, classify, search precedents, rank causes and draft only the questions the evidence cannot answer.

recipes.name: 24-hour KPI watchdog
recipes.instructions: Track each open ticket's age. Note at 12 h, alert at 18 h, urgent at 22 h, with one next action. Block KPI wording in caller drafts.

recipes.name: Access investigation
recipes.instructions: Check the affected person's site, role, project flags and CTMF category against the validated rights matrix. Say which source was used.

recipes.name: KM/LBA redirect and closure
recipes.trigger_label: Event · step belongs to the site KM/LBA
recipes.instructions: Draft the redirect with the exact Doxis steps and the KM/LBA names. Ask the caller to close. No KPI wording.

recipes.name: On Hold chaser
recipes.trigger_label: Poll · replies every 10 min; chase at 13:30 IST
recipes.instructions: Classify replies. Draft reminders on day 1, 3 and 5. Treat only an explicit confirmation as fixed.

recipes.name: Refresh on request
recipes.trigger_label: Poll · Teams every 5 min for refresh asks
recipes.instructions: Find the dataset from the app link, check history, source freshness and the daily cap, and ask me before refreshing.

recipes.name: Refresh health and freshness
recipes.instructions: Compare today's durations with the 30-day median and check source row growth. Numbers come from code.

recipes.name: SharePoint history completeness
recipes.instructions: Check every expected site has a row in each history list for the period. Draft reminders for missing sites.

recipes.name: Enhancement request tracker
recipes.instructions: Turn stakeholder enhancement emails into backlog items and draft acknowledgements. Needs the data rule for email text.

recipes.name: Teams and meeting intake
recipes.trigger_label: Poll · chats every 10 min; 30 min after meetings
recipes.instructions: Pull Power BI issues and my action items out of chats and transcripts. Needs the data rule for chat text.
